page.layout: One block of running text at the top of the page, full width, ending with a centred closing line; below it, a printer's ornament (woodcut tailpiece). No margin notes, page number or running head.

main_text.p: nisi inter triumphantes comas. Sed cùm con-sultius sit, plura hodie tacere, quàm eloqui, concludam orationem meam, id solum ro-gans, ut legens illam, non universitati ejus at-tendas, verum etiam particulari sensui. Vale & Amico Veteri veterem offer animum, & officia à me expecta perpetuò prompta:

page.notes: The printer's ornament below the text is a woodcut tailpiece of interlocking spirals with a central vertical element and a pendant at the foot; it is not text and is not transcribed. The first line begins mid-sentence, so the paragraph is marked as continuing from the previous page. "Iterum Vale." is a centred closing line, set as a paragraph. The colon after "prompta" is as printed.
